Market today: The mood is mixed, with some tech/AI concerns emerging. The real driver for your names today seems to be the evolving narrative around AI spending and chip sector profitability, rather than broad market moves.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.56%), SPAL (-40%), and SMH (-11.86%) need immediate attention. Both SOXL and SPAL are leveraged, decaying ETFs, and your margin amplifies these significant drops. QQQI (-3.67%) is also in the red.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding AI chip financing and the broader implications of high AI spending impacting tech company profits. Also, monitor your leveraged positions for stop breaches.

Bottom line: Your leveraged, deep-red positions are the primary risk; manage them aggressively to protect capital.
plays: SOXL: Your -52.56% loss is critical. Consider trimming or exiting if it approaches your default stop of 200, given its leveraged nature and decay.
SPAL: This new, leveraged position is down 40%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to prevent further deep losses, given its volatility.
SMH/QQQI: Both are in the red and marked "TRIM." Review your conviction and consider reducing exposure if they break their stops at 540 and 52 respectively.
